summary: The document describes the development of an organophotoredox catalytic enantioselective addition of N-acyl radicals to aldehydes. It details the optimization of reaction conditions in batch using various light sources and catalysts, and demonstrates the transition to continuous flow reactors to improve productivity and space-time yields.
